objective: Build a separate order-invariant complete-sequence candidate that preserves native identities, exposes competing paths and withholds ambiguous admissions without replacing frozen science receipts
source_rule: Use the census loader's complete frozen 10,329-record raw snapshot and exact acquisition/algorithm pins. No additional source or image acquisition.
candidate_rule: Enumerate all native-ID paths starting at bracket value 0 under the six pinned patterns, consecutive numeric shutter/file counters, serial and optical-setting equality, required bracket mode/order and at most ten seconds. Never select a path by input order or by maximizing counts. Additionally require explicit-offset, nondecreasing recorded times across all slots. Preserve all native records and original side metadata.
family_rule: Native paths sharing the same ordered nine-field metadata keys form a lossless candidate family, not a physical merge. All slot alternatives and original target/activity fields remain visible. No representative is chosen.
abstention_rule: A family with a multi-ID slot is IDENTITY_ALTERNATIVES_ABSTAIN. Families in a connected component sharing any native ID are COMPETING_PATHS_ABSTAIN. Only a one-ID-per-slot family with no competing path is UNAMBIGUOUS_METADATA_SEQUENCE; this is computational support, not physical or scientific acceptance.
oracles: All frozen baseline native paths accounted for as supported or explicitly excluded
Competing-time-path abstention and no-tie hard negatives
stop: Fail closed on a source/hash/scope/baseline discrepancy, duplicate native ID, budget overflow, incomplete ambiguity component or unexplained baseline exclusion. Preserve old route and receipts; candidate failure does not authorize a physical merge, count rewrite or external effect.
